text:
Sam: Quick question — If you could permanently claim one shelf in the office kitchen/fridge for your stuff, what would you store there? non-work poll :snowman:
Maya: Snacks. All the snacks. Emergency cookies and instant noodles. :cookie:
Devon: A tiny bookshelf. Trade snacks for books? 😂
Liz: Plants. One shelf for low-light survivors and plant names. "Gerald" has first dibs.
Andrew: A mini-fancy coffee setup: beans, hand grinder, tamper. Keep it classy. ☕️
Sam: @Maya that's terrifyingly practical. @Devon love it — swap system? :handshake:
Maya: Trade proposal: 3 cookies = 1 paperback. In-person barter only.
Devon: Deal. I'll leave a note on my 'bookshelf' with a QR for the barter ledger :ledger:
ops-bot: Reminder — shared spaces are to be labeled with owner and expiration (if food). Please keep allergens noted.
Liz: Also, can we get a tiny sign: "Shelf claimed by Gerald (Liz)" ? :grin:
Andrew: If someone's claiming coffee gear, I volunteer to maintain it on rotation. :mechanical_arm:
Maya: Vote: snacks shelf gets a tiny lock or a polite sticky note? :lock:
Sam: Sticky note + shame system. Works for me. :zipper_mouth_face:
Devon: I'll draw a tiny label. Who wants to sign their shelf emoji? I'll start: 📚
Liz: 🌿
Maya: 🍪
Andrew: ☕️
Sam: I'll add a paper 'no judgy snack police' sign. This is officially our most accelerated office governance.
Maya: Petition to rename the kitchen shelf to "The Commons"? :ballot_box_with_check:
Sam: +1 "The Commons". Anyone opposed?
Devon: Not opposed. Will accept cookies as dissent.
Sam: Thanks all. Small follow-up: if you actually want to claim a shelf, DM me and I'll slap a label in the morning.
